label: Diagram 11.5
caption: Diagram 11.5 Small unprotected areas that may be disregarded in assessing the separation distance from the boundary
description: This is a plan view, headed "See para 11.11". It shows a building outline with a "Roof" block at the top and a grey horizontal band at the bottom. A vertical dashed line is labelled "Compartment wall" and a horizontal dashed line "Compartment floor", dividing the plan into areas. Within these are various squares and paired rectangles, linked by green double-headed arrows marked "a" and "b". A grey vertical strip appears at the right edge. Two side notes read: "Roofs pitched at an angle of less than 70 degrees may be disregarded for separation distance purposes", pointing to the roof, and "The unprotected area of the external wall of a stairway forming a protected shaft may be disregarded for separation distance purposes", pointing to the grey strip. A legend defines the large square and the paired rectangles as "Represents an unprotected area of not more than 1m 2 which may consist of two or more smaller areas within an area of 1000mm x 1000mm", and the small square as "Represents an area of not more than 0.1m 2". Under "Dimensional restrictions", arrow "a" equals 4000mm minimum distance and arrow "b" equals 1500mm minimum distance. A green band along the bottom of the image reads "Diagram 11.5 Small unprotected areas that may be disregarded in assessing the separation distance from the boundary".
